verse: Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is just. Honor your father and your mother, which is the first commandment with a promise: so that it may be well with you, and so that you may have a long life upon the earth. (Eph 6:1-3)
Let each one fear his father and his mother. (Lev 19:3)
With your whole heart, honor your father. And you should not forget the birth pangs of your mother. (Sir 7:27)
Remember that you would not have been born except through your parents; how can you repay what they have given to you? (Sir 7:28)
One’s glory comes from the honor of his father, and a father without honor is a disgrace to his child. (Sir 3:11)
Honor your father and your mother, so that you may have a long life upon the land, which the Lord your God will give to you. (Exo 20:12)
Children, obey your parents in all things. For this is well-pleasing to the Lord. (Col 3:20)
Listen to the judgment of your father, and act accordingly, so that you may be saved. (Sir 3:1)
The Lord has honored the father above his children, and he establishes a mother’s right over her children. (Sir 3:2)
Those who honor their father atone for sins, and those who honor their mother are like those who store up treasure. (Sir 3:3-4)
Whoever honors his father will find joy in his children, and when he prays, he will be heard. (Sir 3:5)

Honor your father and your mother, as the Lord your God has commanded you, so that you may live a long time and that it may go well with you in the land that the Lord your God is giving you. (Deut 5:16)
The father of the righteous will greatly rejoice; he who has begotten a wise child will rejoice in him. (Pro 23:24)
Let your father and mother rejoice; let her who bore you be glad. (Pro 23:25)
Honor your father in word and deed, that a blessing may come upon you from him. (Sir 3:8)
Listen, children, to the instruction of a father, and pay attention, so that you may gain understanding. (Pro 4:1)
My child, hear your father’s instruction, and do not forsake your mother’s teaching. For they will be a graceful crown upon your head and pendants around your neck. (Pro 1:8-9)
A wise child loves discipline. But a scoffer does not listen when he is reproved. (Pro 13:1)
A fool despises at the discipline of his father, but whoever keeps correction becomes wise. (Pro 15:5)
When you sit in the midst of great men, remember your father and mother. (Sir 23:14)
Whoever mistreats his father and drives away his mother causes shame and brings reproach. (Pro 19:26)
Whoever strikes his father or mother shall be surely put to death. (Exo 21:15)
Whoever curses his father or his mother, his lamp will be put out in deepest darkness. (Pro 20:20)
The blessing of the father strengthens the houses of the children; but the curse of the mother uproots even its foundation. (Sir 3:9)
My child, care for your father in his old age, and do not grieve him during his life. (Sir 3:12)
You should not despise a man in his old age. For we are all subject to growing old. (Sir 8:6)
The eye of one who mocks his father and who despises to obey his mother, let the ravens of the valley tear it out, and let the vultures consume it. (Pro 30:17)
Listen to your father, who gave you life, and do not despise your mother when she is old. (Pro 23:22)
Those who abandon their father are like blasphemers, and those who anger their mother is accursed by God. (Sir 3:16)
Do not seek glory by dishonoring your father, for it brings no glory to you in your father's dishonor. (Sir 3:10)
Do not allow the discourse of your elders to pass you by, for they learned from their parents. From them you will learn understanding and how to give an answer in a time of necessity. (Sir 8:9)

Kindness shown to a father will not be forgotten; it will be counted to you against your sins. In the day of trouble, it will be remembered in your favor; like frost before the sun, your sins will melt away. (Sir 3:14-15)
Those who honor their father will have a long life, and those who honor their mother obey the Lord. They serve their parents as masters, for it was they who gave them life. (Sir 3:6-7)
The way of life is for those who observe discipline, but whoever abandons correction goes astray. (Pro 10:17)
A rebuke has greater effect on a wise man than a hundred blows on a fool. (Pro 17:10)
My child, from your youth choose discipline, and even in old age you will still find wisdom. (Sir 6:18)
You who are younger, be subject to the elders. (1 Pet 5:5)
Listen to counsel and accept discipline, that you may be wise in your latter days. (Pro 19:20)
For the commandment is a lamp and the law is light, and the reproofs of discipline are the way of life. (Pro 6:23)

My child, keep your father’s precepts, and do not abandon your mother’s teaching. Bind them always to your heart and wear them around your neck. When you walk, they will guide you; when you sleep, they will watch over you; and when you wake up, they will speak to you. (Pro 6:20-22)
Poverty and disgrace come to him who ignores instruction, but whoever accepts correction will be honored. (Pro 13:18)
No discipline seems pleasant at the time, but painful. Later on, however, it produces a peaceful fruit of righteousness for those who have been trained by it. (Heb 12:11)
He went with them and came to Nazareth. And he was obedient to them. And his mother kept all these things in her heart. (Luk 2:51)
Does the Lord delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices as much as in obeying the voice of the Lord? for obedience is better than sacrifice, and to heed is better than the fat of rams. (1 Sam 15:22)
For rebellion is like the sin of divination, and stubbornness is like wickedness and idolatry. (1 Sam 15:23)
Whoever loves discipline loves knowledge. But he who hates reproof is foolish. (Pro 12:1)
Whoever neglects discipline despises himself, but he who listens to reproof gains understanding. (Pro 15:32)

Be subject for the Lord’s sake to every human institution, whether to the emperor as supreme, or to governors as sent by him to punish those who do evil and to praise those who do good. (1 Pet 2:13-14)

Let every person be subject to the governing authorities, for there is no authority except from God, and those that exist are instituted by God. Therefore, whoever resists authority resists what God has appointed, and those who resist will bring judgment upon themselves. (Rom 13:1–2)
Admonish them to be subject to rulers and authorities, to be obedient, to be prepared for every good work. (Tit 3:1)
